{{Dialogue|Bwua'tu|Razelle, Master. ''Vaala'' Razelle.|Hamner|Vaala Razelle?|Razelle|My name, Master. You didn't seem to know it.|attr=Bwua'tu, Hamner, and Razelle|src=<ref name="Vortex" />}}
'''Vaala Razelle''' was an [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] of the [[New Jedi Order]]. In [[44 ABY]], she was stationed alongside [[Yantahar Bwua'tu]] to guard the entrance to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Operations Hangar]] in the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] while the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] prepared to launch a strike team of [[StealthX]]s to help [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in his dealings with the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. They were confronted by [[Kenth Hamner]], who had recently been removed from the position of acting Grand Master by the rest of the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council]]. He claimed that by letting the StealthXs launch, Razelle and Bwua'tu were committing an act of [[Treason/Legends|treason]]. When Razelle and Bwua'tu refused to stand down, he knocked them unconscious. However, Hamner [[Skirmish in the Operations Hangar|failed]] to prevent the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] from launching. Later, she took part in the Jedi mission to [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|liberate]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] from the Sith Tribe, who had infiltrated the world.

==Biography==
{{Dialogue|Bwua'tu|There are hundreds of Sith running loose in the galaxy, and Chief Daala is preventing us from going to meet them. We have no choice.|Hamner|Son, we ''always'' have a choice. Will you stand aside so I can stop this?|Razelle|I'm sorry, Master Hamner. You should return to your quarters now.|attr=Bwua'tu, Hamner, and Razelle, shortly before Hamner attacks the two|src=<ref name="Vortex" />}}
Vaala Razelle was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] who rose to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] in the [[New Jedi Order]] by [[44 ABY]]. At that [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] was in conflict with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Order due to several Jedi Knights falling prey to a [[Force psychosis]]. Meanwhile, [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] encountered a new [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith Tribe]], and the Jedi decided that they needed to send a strike team of [[StealthX]]s to assist him; however, the [[Sixth Fleet|Galactic Alliance Sixth Fleet]] remained in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], ready to engage the Jedi [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] in fear that the strike would be against the Galactic Alliance.<ref name="Vortex" />

[[File:KenthHamner-Vortex.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Kenth Hamner]]
Following a fall-out between acting Grand [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Kenth Hamner]] and the rest of the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council]], Razelle was stationed alongside fellow Jedi Knight [[Yantahar Bwua'tu]] outside of the entrance to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Operations Hangar]] of the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] while the StealthXs prepared to launch. Hamner had been confined to his quarters following the Council's [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|vote of no-confidence]] in his leadership, but he escaped and made his way to the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], confronting Razelle and Bwua'tu. Razelle began to reach for her [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], but Hamner used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|knock aside]] her [[Limb/Legends|hand]]. He insisted that by allowing the StealthXs to launch they were committing an act of treason against the Galactic Alliance, but neither Jedi Knight responded.<ref name="Vortex" />

When Hamner neglected to call either Jedi by name, Bwua'tu supplied Razelle's&mdash;Hamner apologized, and after learning that Bwua'tu was a relative of Alliance [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nek Bwua'tu]], he attempted to play on his relation. When Bwua'tu remained resolute, Hamner requested one last [[Time/Legends|time]] that they step aside, but Razelle suggested that he return to his quarters. Angered, Hamner suddenly [[Unarmed combat/Legends|attacked]] them, knocking Razelle unconscious with a punch to the sensitive organ between her [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and subduing Bwua'tu with a blow to his jaw. Hamner nevertheless [[Skirmish in the Operations Hangar|failed]] to stop the launch and [[Death/Legends|died]] in the attempt.<ref name="Vortex" />

The Jedi Order later departed Coruscant in an attempt to lure the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Tribe into a trap. Razelle was one of the many Jedi who led the efforts to [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|liberate]] Coruscant from the Sith. She traveled with Jedi Knights [[Bazel Warv]] and [[Seff Hellin]]&mdash;to get past the Sith agents who had infiltrated the planet, Warv posed as a renowned wrestler, Hellin as his manager, and Razelle as the manager's assistant. As they moved through the immigration inspection line at the [[Galactic Center Spaceport]], however, they noticed that two nearby Jedi, Yantahar Bwua'tu and [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]], had come under suspicion by Sith [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Suhale]].<ref name="Apoc">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>

Razelle and Hellin tried to keep Warv moving, but he refused to leave his friends behind. Much to Razelle's dismay, Warv ignored their pleas and took several cases of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] from a group of four [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] by pretending to be their contact. Razelle and Hellin quickly caught on to his plan, and helped him take the cases. Warv promised to meet them at the rendezvous point, and he successfully to tricked the Sith into thinking that Saav'etu and Bwua'tu were simply spice smugglers.<ref name="Apoc" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|That's ''Grand'' Master.''"<br />"''Sorry, sir, I didn't&hellip;|Hamner and Razelle|<ref name="Vortex" />}}
Vaala Razelle was loyal to the Jedi Order, standing up to Kenth Hamner when he declared that what she was doing was an act of treason against the Galactic Alliance. When Hamner apologized for not knowing her name and explained that it was difficult to recognize all of the Jedi in the Order, she simply nodded, accepting his explanation. Razelle recognized the threat that the Sith presented to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and refused to step aside to let Hamner into the hangar, even suggesting that he return to his quarters, where he was supposed to be confined. Hamner grew angry after she called him "Master" and insisted that his title was "Grand Master"; however, when she began to apologize, she was cut off by his attack.<ref name="Vortex" />

During the early stages of the liberation of Coruscant, Razelle objected to Warv's desire to interfere with the Sith who were inspecting Saav'etu and Bwua'tu. She felt that a last-minute change to the plan was a bad idea, and that they would draw attention to themselves. However, when she recognized Warv's plan to convince Suhale that the suspicion she was feeling for the two Jedi was because they were spice smugglers, she assisted him in commandeering the spice.<ref name="Apoc" />

Razelle was short in stature for an Arcona&mdash;the top of her head only reaching Hamner's chin&mdash;and had bright [[Green (disambiguation)|green]] eyes that betrayed the fact that, unlike many members of her [[Species/Legends|species]], Razelle managed to avoid addiction to [[Salt/Legends|salt]].<ref name="Vortex" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Yant, watch&mdash;!|Razelle attempts to warn Bwua'tu of Hamner's imminent attack|<ref name="Vortex" />}}
The Arcona Vaala Razelle completed her [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] as a Jedi and achieved the rank of Jedi Knight by 44 ABY. When confronted by Kenth Hamner, she [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] that he was about to attack and attempted to warn Bwua'tu, but the warning came too late&mdash;Hamner used the Force to disarm them and quickly knocked both unconscious.<ref name="Vortex" /> For the mission to free Coruscant from the Sith, Razelle and the rest of the Jedi studied how to conceal lies and their Force presences from the Sith who had infiltrated the planet.<ref name="Apoc" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vaala Razelle first appeared briefly in [[Troy Denning]]'s ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]'', book six in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series, released [[November 30]], [[2010]]. She later received a small role in Denning's ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]'', the ninth and final ''Fate of the Jedi'' novel, released [[March 13]], [[2012]].
